Resolves to the party of the presidential ticket that gets Oklahoma's electoral votes in the November 4, 2036 election, however Oklahoma awards them: by its own vote, by the national popular vote under an interstate compact, or any other way. If electoral votes are replaced by another system, it follows whatever say Oklahoma has in that system; N/A if it has none.

Only the party matters: a ticket on the Democratic or Republican line counts as that party even if also listed on other parties' lines. Any other ticket resolves to Other, or to its own answer if one has been added.

Resolves on the electors Oklahoma certifies, or earlier once the AP has called the state and nothing could change it. Faithless electors don't change it.

seed.basis: Opening odds are a starting point, not a forecast. Oklahoma voted 35.9 points more Republican than the country in the 2020 and 2024 presidential elections; pulled toward even for a race this far off, that gives Democrats 1% and Republicans 98%. Other opens at 1%.
